svg.text: AI systems that are grounded, tested, and honest_
The model proposes, the code disposes.
The model holds the conversation. Tested code makes every decision that matters.
I build retrieval, agents, MCP servers, voice, and automation with that one rule at the center. The flagships ship
deterministic test suites that need no API key and show captured output from actual runs; every README is honest
about the trade-offs. The console below counts the public repos and the tests their READMEs state, fresh every
weekday; one rule runs through all of them.
My client work is under NDA and stays private. These public projects are built to the same standard, and show how I work: grounded,
